hook: A 46.5-million-cell atlas across 160 diseases reveals shared cell-response patterns across organs.
hook_turn: reveals shared cell-response patterns across organs.
summary: PANGEA remaps public single-cell data with an automated pipeline and a 32-type, 165-subtype cell classification, then compares disease responses across 48 organs. It finds recurring disease archetypes and works as a reference for spatial transcriptomics. It rests on public datasets of uneven quality, so batch and sampling biases may remain.
title: PANGEA: an integrated cell atlas across diverse biological contexts enables systematic profiling of multicellular responses in human diseases.
